about: Recorded drand beacons, copied by hand from drand's own test suites (the network relay api.drand.sh is not reachable from the build sandbox). Each is a real beacon signed by its chain's threshold key: the BLS check in both implementations is the evidence, since nobody without that key can produce a signature that verifies.

beacons.name: default-mainnet-2634945
beacons.source: github.com/drand/drand/v2@v2.1.7 crypto/schemes_test.go TestVerifyBeacon (Go module proxy), League of Entropy mainnet 'default' chain

beacons.name: walkthrough-rfc9380-38
